label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter 'BenchmarkTest02465' flows through doSomething where it is assigned to bar unless a numeric check fails (which is always true here since 420-106=314>200), then concatenated into fileName which is used directly in FileInputStream constructor. The HTML-encoded fileName is printed but the actual file read operation uses unsanitized user input, enabling path traversal attacks.

evidence.note: User input flows to fileName via concatenation with TESTFILES_DIR, then passed to FileInputStream without validation against directory boundaries
